title: Unshakable Love
story:
A small village once faced a powerful earthquake warning.

People rushed to secure their homes.

Fear spread everywhere.

Buildings were unstable.

People did not know what would remain standing.

In the middle of the village stood an old stone well.

It had been there for generations.

No matter how strong the winds or tremors were, it remained firm.

People would gather near it for water and safety.

One elder said,

“Everything around us may shake, but this remains steady.”

In life, many things are unstable.

Relationships change.

Circumstances shift.

Plans fail.

But God’s love is different.

Even when everything shakes, His covenant of peace remains unbroken.

His compassion does not move.

And His love never fails.
life_lesson: God’s love and peace remain unshakable even when life changes.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for Your unshakable love.

When everything around me feels unstable, help me to rest in Your peace.

Remind me that Your compassion never fails.

Strengthen my heart with Your covenant of love.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What areas of your life feel unstable right now?

How does God’s unchanging love bring you peace?

Can you trust His covenant even in uncertain times?
verse:
Though the mountains be shaken and the hills be removed,
yet My unfailing love for you will not be shaken
nor My covenant of peace be removed,
says the Lord, who has compassion on you.
